notes.title: Dear Guests! Postponing release and news about demo!
notes.notes:
Our kitchen is a little overwhelmed, and the main dish — Kill Ralph — needs more time to be cooked to perfection.
That means your order (the full release) will now be served on October 22th.
But don’t worry, we won’t leave you hungry!
On September 28th, we’ll bring you a little appetizer — the demo version — so you can get a taste while waiting for the main course.
Thank you for your patience and for staying with us — things are about to get spicy!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45489894/39bba1f792837dd7eab935b60ac702378d74b157.png"]

notes.title: Catch the big reveal: our game and release date at the Ukrainian Festival!
notes.notes:
Hello,

I am happy to announce that Kill Ralph will be releasing on September 29th. 

Wishlist it, buy and toss a coin to your artist. If you love it - buy a few more copies for your friends, if you hate it - buy them for your enemies, for everyone else there's piracy. 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45489894/bc5be94c3eac880eec86bbbccdbd57cbae3e2fcc.png"]

See you,

Andrii Tuzenko
